newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent Group Three unleaded basis firms.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent Group Three unleaded basis firms.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded gasoline basis firmed in Group Three on Thursday, offsetting a modest decline in gasoline futures, traders said.

Traders said a shipping delay on the Mississippi River sparked some bullishness in a market that has been drifting lower on high inventory levels on hand at regional refineries and the Williams pipeline system.
A northbound gasoline-laden barge ran aground 18 miles south of Memphis, Tenn., spilling 15,000 gallons of gasoline and closing a 13-mile stretch of the river.
Unleaded gasoline firmed to bids 3.0 cents a gallon under NYMEX February unleaded in Group Three and remained 0.50 cent under the print in Chicago, traders said.
Low sulphur diesel was steady at bids 4.50 cents a gallon under NYMEX February heating oil in Group Three and 5.0 cents under the print in Chicago.
High sulphur diesel remained bid 8.50 cents a gallon under the print in Group Three and 6.0 cents under the print in Chicago.
